ItemID: unavailable; Title: 5/16 x 5-1/2" (8 pcs) Hex Lag Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Hexagon Head Lag Bolts, Hex Head Wood Screws; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These large lag screws are too specific without a matching heavy wood project in mind.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rubber Grommets Kit,Hincell 63Pcs Double Sided Round Rubber Grommet Kit for Wiring Drill Hole Firewall Hole Plugs Wire Protection for Automotive Plumbing, 6 Sizes 5/8" 13/16" 7/8" 1" 1-3/16" 1-1/2"; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose these to protect wiring through drilled holes; they complement my drilling and fastening supplies.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Clockwise Tools DVLR-0805 Vernier Caliper Inch/Metric 0-8 Inch/200 mm Stainless Steel Body Measuring Tool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently picked up a digital caliper and do not currently need another measuring tool.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: M3 Flat Head Wood Screws Assortment Fasteners Kit 420pcs,Phillips Drive Countersunk Head Self-Tapping Screws,Carbon Steel,Contains 20pcs M6 Screw Anchors; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Small wood screws fit my projects, but I would check my existing screw assortment before buying more.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: M6-1.0 x 30mm (20 Pcs) Socket Head Cap Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, DIN912; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my interest in metric hardware, but I would need to confirm the exact length and thread for a project.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Okebond Super Glue Clear Strong Repair (Blue OB-4700+1pcs); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Repair adhesive is useful to me, but the title gives too little information about suitable materials to choose it now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Bondic GO UV Glue Kit with Light, Super Glue, Liquid Plastic Welding Kit, (3ml) Adhesive Epoxy UV Glue, Bonds & Cures Instantly, Non-Toxic UV Resin Glue, Heat-Resistant & Waterproof, 1PK; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for small repairs where controlled curing could be more convenient than my bulk epoxy.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sali 10 Pack Zirconia Flap Disc 80 Grit 4.5" x 7/8-Inch Sanding Disc Bevel Type #29 Premium and Industrial Angle Grinder Grinding Wheel Grade High Performance Edge Grinding; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Finishing rough edges after cutting fits my recent tool purchases; I would choose these after checking grinder compatibility.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Eventek Infrared Thermometer Gun, [3 in 1] -58°F~1112°F (-50°C~600°C) Digital Laser Temperature Gun for Cooking, Pizza Oven, Grill & Engine with Adjustable Emissivity, Meat Thermometer & Bag Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I just bought an infrared thermometer, so another one has little immediate value.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: AIRIC 3/8 inch Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Small Marine Grade Shrinking Cable Tube Dual Wall Adhesive Shrinkable Wire Wrap Tubes Roll, Fully Insulation (20 Feet Black Tubing, and 20 Feet Red Tubing); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for insulating and organizing repair wiring, provided the tubing diameter fits my cables.
